visual_argument: One parcel and the paper a camera hands to people. At one paper scale, one card of 0.2 mm per property scanned, the city memo's 10,000 properties stand as a column of cards taller than the code officer beside it, and the 57 citations are the sheaf in his hands. On the next frame the 57 citation cards lie fanned on the street at the same 0.2 mm card, 39 left of a painted lane line for the citations the city manager's memo places in Council Districts 4, 8 and 7 and the rest to its right. Re-sourced on November 8th from the September 8th memo as FOX 4 and Dallas Express reported it.
build_risk: A new paper_column model whose natural failure is a white pillar or a rounded box at feed size, beside a kit person at face scale who can read as a mannequin. Built as 40 misregistered bundles with kraft bands and a broken top bundle, raked by the low lastLight key, the person three quarters on and lit from the camera's side.
distinct_from_recent: No. 70 was a rig floor at night under a cold flood with a robot gripper as its hero. No. 69 was a dark dock bay lit through its door. No. 68 was a Permian well pad at last light with rods and coins as counters. This is a residential Dallas street, a code office and a council room, with paper at true thickness as the counter and a person in every frame after the camera.
